entries.matn_en: he said: It has reached us that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “While I was asleep, I saw myself brought a cup of milk, and I drank from it, until I saw satiety (riyy) flow out into my extremities; and I gave my remainder to 'Umar b. al-Khattab.” Those around him said: “What did you interpret that as, Messenger of God?” He said: “Knowledge.” Ibrahim b. Sa'd said: And Salih b. Kaysan narrated this hadith to me from Hamzah b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar.

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 98
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: اسْتَأْذَنَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعِنْدَهُ نِسَاءٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ يُكَلِّمْنَهُ وَيَسْتَكْثِرْنَهُ، عَالِيَةً أَصْوَاتُهُنَّ عَلَى صَوْتِهِ، فَلَمَّا اسْتَأْذَنَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ، تَبَادَرْنَ الْحِجَابَ، فَأَذِنَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَدَخَلَ عُمَرُ، وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَضْحَكُ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: أَضْحَكَ اللَّهُ سِنَّكَ، بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ. فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «عَجِبْتُ مِنْ هَؤُلاءِ اللاتِي كُنَّ عِنْدِي، فَلَمَّا سَمِعْنَ صَوْتَكَ تَبَادَرْنَ الْحِجَابَ» . فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: فَأَنْتَ كُنْتَ أَحَقَّ أَنْ يَهَبْنَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ. ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِنَّ، فَقَالَ: أَي عَدُوَّاتِ أَنْفُسِهِنَّ أَتَهَبْنَنِي وَلَمْ تَهَبْنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ قُلْنَ: نَعَمْ، أَنْتَ أَغْلَظُ وَأَفَظُّ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم. قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّهَا يَابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ مَا لَقِيَكَ الشَّيْطَانُ قَطُّ سَالِكًا فَجًّا، إِلا سَلَكَ فَجًّا غَيْرَ فَجِّكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Salih b. Kaysan, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Abd al-Hamid b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Zayd, from Muhammad b. Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab asked permission to enter upon the Messenger of God ﷺ, while there were women of Quraysh with him, talking to him and asking much of him, their voices raised above his voice. When 'Umar b. al-Khattab asked permission, they hurried to the veil (hijab). The Messenger of God ﷺ gave him permission, and 'Umar entered while the Messenger of God ﷺ was laughing. 'Umar said: “May God keep you laughing, Messenger of God—my father and mother be your ransom!” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “I marveled at these women who were with me; when they heard your voice, they hurried to the veil.” 'Umar said: “You were more deserving that they should hold you in awe, Messenger of God.” Then he turned to them and said: “O enemies of yourselves, do you hold me in awe and not hold the Messenger of God ﷺ in awe?” They said: “Yes; you are harsher and sterner than the Messenger of God ﷺ.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Indeed, son of al-Khattab—by the One in whose hand is my soul—Satan never meets you going along a path but that he takes a path other than your path.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 99
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «بَيْنَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ رَأَيْتُنِي عَلَى قَطِيبٍ فَنَزَعْتُ مِنْهَا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ أَنْزِعَ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا ابْنُ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ ، فَنَزَعَ ذَنُوبًا أَوْ ذَنُوبَيْنِ، وَفِي نَزْعِهِ ضَعْفٌ، لِيَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ، فَاسْتَحَالَتْ غَرْبًا، فَلَمْ أَرَ عَبْقَرِيًّا مِنَ النَّاسِ يَنْزِعُ نَزْعَهُ، حَتَّى ضَرَبَ النَّاسَ بِعَطَنٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Salih b. Kaysan, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurayrah, that he said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say:
entries.matn_en: “While I was asleep, I saw myself at a well (qatib [as printed]); I drew from it what God willed that I draw. Then Ibn Abi Quhafah took it and drew a bucket or two, and in his drawing there was weakness—may God forgive him. Then 'Umar b. al-Khattab took it, and it turned into a great bucket (gharb), and I did not see any genius ('abqari) among the people draw as he drew, until the people watered their camels and brought them to rest ('atan).”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 99
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: «أَنَّهُ قَدْ كَانَ فِيمَا مَضَى قَبْلَكُمْ مِنَ الأُمَمِ مُحَدَّثُونَ، فَإِنْ يَكُنْ فِي أُمَّتِي هَذِهِ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ، فَإِنَّهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Sa'd b. Ibrahim, from Abu Salamah b. 'Abd al-Rahman, that
entries.matn_en: he said: It has reached me that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Among the nations that came before you there were muhaddathun [those inspired]; and if there is one of them in this community of mine, it is 'Umar b. al-Khattab.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 99
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ: «قُرَيْشٌ أَحَقُّ النَّاسِ بِهَذَا الْمَالِ، لأَنَّهُمْ إِذَا أَعْطُوا فَاضَ، وَإِذَا أَعْطَتْهُ غَيْرُهُمْ لَمْ يَفِضْ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Salih b. Kaysan, from Ibn Shihab, that
entries.matn_en: he said: It has reached me that 'Umar b. al-Khattab said: “Quraysh are the most deserving of people of this wealth, because when they give, it overflows, and when others give it, it does not overflow.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 99
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ،
entries.matn_ar:
أَنَّ أَبَا قَتَادَةَ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، ثُمَّ السُّلَمِيَّ، قَالَ لِخَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ: " هَذَا يَوْمٌ يُذِلُّ اللَّهُ فِيهِ قُرَيْشًا . فَقَالَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَلا تَسْمَعُ مَا يَقُولُ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَهْلا يَا أَبَا قَتَادَةَ، فَإِنَّكَ لَوْ وَزَنْتَ حِلْمَكَ مَعَ حُلُومِهِمْ، لَتَحَاقَرْتَ حِلْمَكَ مَعَ حُلُومِهِمْ، وَلَوْ وَزَنْتَ رَأْيَكَ مَعَ رَأْيِهِمْ، لَتَحَاقَرْتَ رَأْيَكَ مَعَ رَأْيِهِمْ، وَلَوْ وَزَنْتَ فِعَالَكَ مَعَ فِعَالِهِمْ، لَتَحَاقَرْتَ فِعْلَكَ مَعَ فِعَالِهِمْ، لا تُعَلِّمُوا

قُرَيْشًا، وَتَعَلَّمُوا مِنْهَا، فَلَوْلا أَنْ تَبْطُرَ قُرَيْشٌ لأَخَبْرَتْهُمْ بِمَا لَهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Muhammad b. 'Ikrimah, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Mulaykah, that
entries.matn_en:
Abu Qatadah al-Ansari, then al-Sulami, said to Khalid b. al-Walid on the day of the Conquest: “This is a day on which God humiliates Quraysh.” Some of the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Do you not hear what Abu Qatadah says, Messenger of God?” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Easy, Abu Qatadah! If you weighed your forbearance against theirs, you would find your forbearance small beside theirs; and if you weighed your judgment against theirs, you would find your judgment small beside theirs; and if you weighed your deeds against theirs, you would find your deeds small beside theirs. Do not teach

Quraysh, but learn from them. Were it not that Quraysh would become arrogant, I would tell them what they have with the Lord of the worlds.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 100
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي خَيْثَمَةَ أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لا تُعَلِّمُوا قُرَيْشًا، وَتَعَلَّمُوا مِنْهَا، وَلا تَتَقَدَّمُوهُمْ، وَلا تَتَأَخَّرُوا عَنْهُمْ، فَإِنَّ لِلرَّجُلِ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ مِثْلَ قُوَّةِ الرَّجُلَيْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ قُرَيْشٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Salih b. Kaysan, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Bakr b. Sulayman b. Abi Khaythamah, that
entries.matn_en: it reached him that the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Do not teach Quraysh, but learn from them; do not go ahead of them, and do not lag behind them; for a man of Quraysh has the strength of two men who are not of Quraysh.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 100
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ أَبِي الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ يُرِدِ هَوَانَ قُرَيْشٍ، أَهَانَهُ اللَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Salih b. Kaysan, from Ibn Shihab, from Muhammad b. Abi Sufyan, from Yusuf b. al-Hakam Abu l-Hajjaj, from Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, who said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever seeks the humiliation of Quraysh, God will humiliate him.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 100
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم " ذُكِرَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ ثَقِيفٍ مَاتَ يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ وَهُوَ حَاضِرٌ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَبْعَدَهُ اللَّهُ ، فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يَبْغَضُ قُرَيْشًا "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Salih b. Kaysan, from Ibn Shihab, that
entries.matn_en: he said: It has reached me that the Messenger of God ﷺ was told of a man of Thaqif who died on the day of Hunayn while present there, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “May God put him far away, for he used to hate Quraysh.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 100
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، أَنَّهُمَا قَالا:
entries.matn_ar: بَيْنَمَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ جَالِسٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، إِذْ مَرَّ بِهِ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْعَاصِ، فَدَعَاهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ، فَقَالَ: " وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي مَا قَتَلْتُ أَبَاكَ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ، وَلَكِنْ قَتَلْتُ خَالِي الْعَاصَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، وَمَا لِي أَنْ أَكُونَ أَعْتَذِرُ مِنْ قَتْلِ مُشْرِكٍ. فَقَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْعَاصِ: كُنْتَ عَلَى حَقٍّ، وَكَانَ عَلَى بَاطِلٍ. فَعَجِبَ مِنْ قَوْلِهِ، وَلَوَى كَفَّيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: قُرَيْشٌ أَفْضَلُ النَّاسِ أَحْلامًا، وَأَعْظَمُ النَّاسِ أَمَانَةً، وَمَنْ يُرِدْ قُرَيْشًا بِسُوءٍ نَكَثَهُ اللَّهُ لَعْنَتَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Muhammad b. 'Ikrimah, from Nafi' b. Jubayr and Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, who both said:
entries.matn_en: One day 'Umar b. al-Khattab was sitting in the mosque when Sa'id ibn al-'As passed by him, and 'Umar b. al-Khattab called him and said: “By God, I did not kill your father on the day of Badr; rather, I killed my maternal uncle al-'As b. Hisham, and it is not for me to apologize for killing a polytheist.” Sa'id ibn al-'As said: “You were in the right, and he was in the wrong.” He marveled at his words, and turned his palms over, and then said: “Quraysh are the best of people in forbearance and the greatest in trustworthiness; and whoever intends evil for Quraysh, God turns His curse upon him.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 101
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِذَا ذُكِرَ عُمَرُ: لِلَّهِ تَأَيَّدَ عُمَرُ، لَقَلَّ مَا رَأَيْتُهُ يُحَرِّكُ شَفَتَيْهِ بِشَيْءٍ قَطُّ إِلا كَانَ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Salih b. Kaysan, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: he used to say, when 'Umar was mentioned: “By God, 'Umar was divinely supported! Seldom did I see him move his lips with anything but that it came to pass.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 101
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ الَّيُهوَد، كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ: إِنَّا نَجِدُ فِيمَا نَقْرَأُ مِنَ الأَحَادِيثِ عَنِ الأَنْبِيَاءِ: أَنَّهُ يُجْلِي يَهُودَ الْحِجَازِ رَجُلٌ صِفَتُهُ صِفَةُ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، فَأَجْلاهُمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Salih b. Kaysan, from Ibn Shihab, that
entries.matn_en: he said: “It has reached me that the Jews used to say: ‘We find in what we read of the reports from the prophets that a man whose description is the description of 'Umar b. al-Khattab will expel the Jews of the Hijaz’; and he expelled them.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 101
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «حَرَّقَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ بَيْتَ رُوَيْشِدٍ، وَكَانَ حَانُوتَ شَرَابٍ» . قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ: فَحَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ: «إِنِّي لأَنْظُرُ إِلَى ذَلِكَ الْبَيْتِ لَيْلا كَأَنَّهُ جَمْرَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: he said: “'Umar b. al-Khattab burned the house of Ruwayshid, which was a wine shop.” Ibrahim b. Sa'd said: My father narrated to me from his grandfather, who said: “I looked at that house at night as if it were a live coal (jamrah).”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 101
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ الْبَصْرِيِّ: " أَنَّ صُهَيْبًا دَخَل عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ حِينَ طُعِنَ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: وَآخَاهُ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: وَيْحَكَ يَا صُهَيْبُ، أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ الْمُعَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ يُعَذَّبَ ". يَعْنِي: الْبُكَاءَ
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from al-Hasan b. Dinar, from al-Hasan al-Basri:
entries.matn_en: “Suhayb entered upon 'Umar b. al-Khattab when he was stabbed, and when he saw him, he said: ‘Oh, my brother!’ 'Umar said: ‘Woe to you, Suhayb, do you not know that the one who is wailed over is punished?’”—meaning weeping.

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 101
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: " دَخَلَ ثَابِتٌ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ شَاهِدٌ، وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، وَزَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ مُضْطَجِعَانِ ، فَلَمَّا نَظَرَ إِلَى أَقْدَامِهِمَا، قَالَ: إِنَّ هَذِهِ الأَقْدَامِ بَعْضُهَا مِنْ بَعْضٍ، فَسُرَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَلِكَ، وَأَعْجَبَهُ، وَأَخْبَرَ بِهِ عَائِشَةَ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwah b. al-Zubayr, from 'A'ishah, that
entries.matn_en: she said: “Thabit [as printed] entered upon the Messenger of God ﷺ while he was present, and Usamah b. Zayd and Zayd b. Harithah were lying down; when he looked at their feet, he said: ‘These feet are some of them from others.’ The Prophet ﷺ was pleased by that and it delighted him, and he told 'A'ishah of it.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 101
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ ابْنَةُ جَحْشٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَكَانَتِ اسْتُحِيضَتْ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ، فَشَكَتْ ذَلِكَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَاسْتَفْتَتْهُ فِيهِ، فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ هَذِهِ لَيْسَ بِحَيْضَةٍ، وَلَكِنْ هَذَا عَرَقٌ، فَاغْتَسِلِي ثُمَّ صَلِّي» . قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: فَكَانَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ تَغْتَسِلُ لِكُلِّ صَلاةٍ، ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي، قَالَتْ: وَكَانَتْ تَجْلِسُ فِي الْمِرْكَنِ، فَتَعْلُو حُمْرَةُ الدَّمِ الْمَاءَ، ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Amrah bint 'Abd al-Rahman, from 'A'ishah ﵂, that
entries.matn_en: she said: Umm Habibah bint Jahsh came to the Messenger of God ﷺ; she had suffered abnormal bleeding (istihadah) for seven years. She complained of that to the Messenger of God ﷺ and asked his ruling on it, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said to her: “This is not menstruation, but it is a vein ('irq); so bathe and then pray.” 'A'ishah said: So Umm Habibah would bathe for every prayer and then pray. She said: And she would sit in the basin, and the redness of the blood would rise above the water; then she would pray.

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 101
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ الأَخْنَسِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar:
مَاتَ مَوْلًى لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْحَبَشَةِ، فَقَالَ:

«انْظُرُوا مَنْ كَانَ بِمَكَّةَ مِنْ مُسْلِمَةِ الْحَبَشَةِ، فَادْفَعُوا مِيرَاثَهُ إِلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Muhammad b. Ishaq, from Ya'qub b. 'Utbah b. al-Mughirah b. al-Akhnas, that
entries.matn_en:
he said: A freedman of the Messenger of God ﷺ from Abyssinia died, and he said:

“Look for whoever of the Muslim Abyssinians is in Mecca, and give his inheritance to him.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 102
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ،
entries.matn_ar: عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ " أَنَّهُ دَعَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ مَعَارِفِهِ إِلَى حِبَّانَ، فَانْصَرَفَ، وَكَانَ طَرِيقٌ عَلَى مَنْزِلِهِ. فَدَخَلَ مَنْزِلَهُ، وَكَانَ أَقَلَّ النَّاسِ فُحْشًا عَلَى جَلِيسِهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِهِ حِينَ جَاوَزَ مَنْزِلَهُ: فُلانٌ دَعَاكَ، وَهَذَا مَنْزِلُهُ، فَسَكَتَ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، أَلَسْتَ تَعْلَمُ حَقَّ الدَّعْوَةِ؟ فَقَالَ: يَا تُسْتَرُ بِالْفَارِسِيَّةِ، يَا بَعِيرٌ أَوْ دَعْوَةٌ هِيَ؟ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Muhammad b. Ishaq, from one who
entries.matn_en: narrated to him, from al-Hasan b. Abi l-Hasan: “A man of his acquaintances invited him to Hibban, and he left. There was a road that passed by his own house, so he entered his house—and he was the least coarse of people toward his companion. One of his companions said to him when he had passed his house: ‘So-and-so invited you, and this is his house.’ He was silent toward him. He said to him: ‘Abu Sa'id, do you not know the right of an invitation?’ He said: ‘Ya tustar’—in Persian—‘O camel! Is that an invitation?’”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 102
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِعَائِشَةَ: " أَرَأَيْتِ قَوْلَ الَّلِه {إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ فَمَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ فَلا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا} [البقرة: 158] . قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ: فَوَاللَّهِ مَا عَلَى أَحَدٍ جُنَاحٌ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ لا يَطُوفَ بِهِمَا، قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: وَلَكِنَّهَا إِنَّمَا أُنْزِلَتْ أَنَّ الأَنْصَارَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسْلِمُوا كَانُوا يَحُجُّونَ لِمَنَاةَ الطَّاغِيَةَ الَّتِي كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ عِنْدَ الْمُشلَّلِ، وَكَانَ مَنْ أَهَلَّ لَهَا يَتَحَرَّجُ أَنْ يَطُوفَ بِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: {إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ فَمَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ فَلا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا} [البقرة: 158] . قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: ثُمَّ قَدْ سَنَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الطَّوَافَ بِهِمَا، لَيْسَ يَنْبَغِي لأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَدَعَ الطَّوَافَ بِهِمَا ". قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ: فَذَكَرْتُ حَدِيثَ عُرْوَةَ هَذَا لأَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، فَقَالَ: وَاللَّهِ إِنَّ هَذَا الْعِلْمَ وَأَمَرَّ مَا كُنْتُ سَمِعْتُهُ، وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ رِجَالا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ، يَقُولُونَ: إِنَّ النَّاسَ، إِلا مَنْ ذَكَرَتْ عَائِشَةُ مِمَّنْ كَانَ يُهِلُّ لِمَنَاةَ الطَّاغِيَةَ، كَانُوا يَطُوفُونَ كُلُّهُمْ بِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، فَلَمَّا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ الطَّوَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ، وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا كُنَّا نَطُوفُ بِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عز وجل: {إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ فَمَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ فَلا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا} [البقرة: 158] . قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ: فَاسْمَعْ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ قَدْ أُنْزِلَتْ فِي الْفَرِيقَيْنِ كِلَيْهِمَا الَّذِينَ كَانُوا يَتَحَرَّجُونَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ أَنْ يَطُوفُوا بِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، وَالَّذِينَ كَانُوا يَطُوفُونَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ بِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، ثُمَّ تَحَرَّجُوا فِي الإِسْلامِ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَ بِالطَّوَافِ بِالْبَيْتِ، وَلَمْ يَأْمُرْ بِالطَّوَافِ بِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، مَعَ طَوَافٍ بِالْبَيْتِ. حَتَّى ذَكَرَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Urwah b. al-Zubayr, that
entries.matn_en: he said to 'A'ishah: “What do you make of the words of God: {Indeed, al-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of God; so whoever performs the pilgrimage to the House or the minor pilgrimage, there is no blame upon him in going around them} [al-Baqarah 2:158]? He said: I said: By God, there is no blame on anyone who does not go around them.” 'A'ishah said: “But it was revealed only because the Ansar, before they accepted Islam, used to make pilgrimage to Manat, the false idol that they worshipped at al-Mushallal, and whoever pronounced the talbiyah for her felt reluctance to go around al-Safa and al-Marwah. So God Most High revealed: {Indeed, al-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of God; so whoever performs the pilgrimage to the House or the minor pilgrimage, there is no blame upon him in going around them} [al-Baqarah 2:158].” 'A'ishah said: “Then the Messenger of God ﷺ made going around them a sunnah; it is not fitting for anyone to leave off going around them.” Al-Zuhri said: I mentioned this hadith of 'Urwah to Abu Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Harith b. Hisham, from 'A'ishah, and he said: “By God, this is knowledge—wa-amarra [as printed]—that I had not heard; and I have heard men of knowledge say that the people—except those whom 'A'ishah mentioned, who used to pronounce the talbiyah for Manat the false idol—all used to go around al-Safa and al-Marwah. When God revealed the circumambulation of the House in the Qur'an and did not mention al-Safa and al-Marwah, they said: ‘Messenger of God, we used to go around al-Safa and al-Marwah,’ so God ﷻ revealed: {Indeed, al-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of God; so whoever performs the pilgrimage to the House or the minor pilgrimage, there is no blame upon him in going around them} [al-Baqarah 2:158].” Abu Bakr b. 'Abd al-Rahman said: “So hear this: the verse was revealed concerning both groups—those who felt reluctance in the Jahiliyyah to go around al-Safa and al-Marwah, and those who used to go around al-Safa and al-Marwah in the Jahiliyyah and then felt reluctance in Islam because God had commanded circumambulation of the House and had not commanded going around al-Safa and al-Marwah along with the circumambulation of the House—until He mentioned it.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 102
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ
entries.matn_ar:
«كَانَ عَبْدُ

الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ لا يُصَلِّي الضُّحَى»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:
entries.matn_en:
“'Abd

al-Rahman b. 'Awf did not pray the duha.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 103
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ مُزَيْنَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُحَدِّثُ فِي مَجْلِسِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ: " قَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ: سَلُوا مُحَمَّدًا، فَإِنْ هُوَ حَكَمَ بِالتَّخْفِيفِ، مَا حَدُّ الزَّانِي إِذَا أُحْصِنَ، فَإِنَّكُمْ قَدْ تَرَكْتُمْ مَا فِي التَّوْرَاةِ، فَإِنْ رَخَّصَ عَلَيْكُمْ، كَانَتْ حُجَّةً "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, from a man of Muzaynah, that
entries.matn_en: he was narrating in the gathering of Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, that he said: Abu Hurayrah informed me, saying: “The Jews said: ‘Ask Muhammad; if he rules with leniency—what is the hadd punishment for the fornicator when he is muhsan (married)—for you have abandoned what is in the Torah; so if he gives you a concession, that will be a proof [for you].’”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 103
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: " لَمَّا جُلِدَ أَبُو بَكْرَةَ، أَمَرَتْ أُمُّهُ بِشَاةٍ، فَذُبِحَتْ، ثُمَّ جَعَلَتْ جِلْدَهَا عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ، قَالَ: فَكَانَ أَبِي، يَقُولُ: مَا ذَاكَ إِلا مِنْ ضَرْبٍ شَدِيدٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:
entries.matn_en: “When Abu Bakrah was flogged, his mother ordered a sheep, and it was slaughtered; then she placed its skin on his back.” He said: My father used to say: “That was only because of a severe beating.”

entries.label: Report
entries.citation: Copy of Ibrāhīm ibn Saʿd · p. 103
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَبِسَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاتَمًا مِنْ وَرِقٍ يَوْمًا وَاحِدًا، فَاتَّخَذَ النَّاسُ خَوَاتِمَ مِنْ وَرِقٍ، قَالَ: فَطَرَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاتَمَهُ، فَطَرَحَ النَّاسَ خَوَاتِيمَهُمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Salih narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, from Anas b. Malik, that
entries.matn_en: he said: “The Prophet ﷺ wore a silver ring for one day, and the people made silver rings; then the Messenger of God ﷺ threw away his ring, and the people threw away their rings.”
